name: Simeon and Levi at Shechem
charge: Deceitful covenant; slaughter of a city for one man's crime
summary: After Dinah's defilement, Jacob's sons answered Shechem deceitfully and required circumcision. Simeon and Levi slew the males while they were sore, and the city was plundered. Judith remembers the sword as vengeance for Dinah; Jacob condemned his sons' fierce anger and pronounced their division in Israel.
offense: They answered Shechem and Hamor deceitfully (Genesis 34:13). They offered union on the condition that every male be circumcised, then attacked while the men were sore (Genesis 34:14-25). Hamor and Shechem were slain, Dinah was taken out, and the sons of Jacob spoiled the city and carried off its households (Genesis 34:26-29). The circumcision proposed as the beginning of peace became the occasion of the sword. Judith's prayer remembers Simeon's sword as vengeance granted by God for the defilement of the maid (Judith 9:2-4). Jacob nevertheless refused to unite his honour with his sons' assembly and condemned their cruelty. The offense against Dinah was real; so was the anger for which the brothers were answerable. Their zeal cannot be described without the judgment Jacob later pronounced upon it.
judgment: On his deathbed Jacob passed sentence: instruments of cruelty are in their habitations (Genesis 49:5); cursed be their anger, for it was fierce. I will divide them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel (Genesis 49:7). Simeon's inheritance lay within Judah's portion (Joshua 19:1-9); Levi received cities among the tribes rather than a single continuous tribal territory (Joshua 21:1-8). The division is a consequence of Jacob's pronouncement, not the disappearance of either tribe.

verses.text: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went out.
The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,
And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.

O Lord God of my father Simeon, to whom thou gavest a sword to take vengeance of the strangers, who loosened the girdle of a maid to defile her, and discovered the thigh to her shame, and polluted her virginity to her reproach; for thou saidst, It shall not be so; and yet they did so:
Wherefore thou gavest their rulers to be slain, so that they dyed their bed in blood, being deceived, and smotest the servants with their lords, and the lords upon their thrones;

And hast given their wives for a prey, and their daughters to be captives, and all their spoils to be divided among thy dear children; which were moved with thy zeal, and abhorred the pollution of their blood, and called upon thee for aid: O God, O my God, hear me also a widow.

text.text: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the Lord, these cities and their suburbs.

And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

lawDetails.text: You shall make no false or deceitful oath or covenant.

entries.commentary: Dinah, Jacob's only daughter, went out to see the daughters of the land without supervision, and Shechem the son of Hamor took her, and lay with her, and defiled her. This was stranger rape. The lesson stands for every generation: keep watch over the daughters. Have a care of their body; do not give overmuch liberty; the father wakes for the daughter and the care for her takes away sleep. Everything the children do should have supervision, especially in this age.

Shechem's soul clave to Dinah after he defiled her; he did it backwards, taking first and loving after. That is the world's pattern, not righteousness. When Jacob's sons heard, the men were grieved and very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter, which thing ought not to be done. The laws were in place and kept long before they were written in stone at Sinai.

Hamor proposed the exact opposite of the law: make ye marriages with us, give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you, and dwell with us, and become one people. Assimilation and intermarriage is the offer the nations always make, and it is the offer the law forbids.

The sons of Jacob answered deceitfully: every male of the city must be circumcised before they would consent. Hamor and Shechem persuaded the whole city, reasoning that the wealth of Jacob's house would become theirs; every male was circumcised.

On the third day, when they were sore, two of the sons, Simeon and Levi, took each man his sword, came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males; they took Dinah out, spoiled the city, and carried away the substance and the households. Two men do not take a city alone. The sword of Simeon was given of God to take vengeance of the strangers that defiled the maid; they were moved with the zeal of the Most High, and He was behind the judgment.

Jacob was troubled: ye have made me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, and I being few in number. He feared the nations round about gathering against his house. The brothers answered, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot? There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel; the daughters of Israel are not to be handled so, and the sons of Israel did not go for it.

Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days. These blessings are twofold: they speak to what would come upon each tribe in their day and in the last days, and they help determine who the tribes are and where they would be found today.

Reuben is the so-called Seminole Indian today. Reuben, thou art my firstborn, the beginning of my strength: the firstborn is the father's posterity, and the excellency of dignity and the excellency of power belonged to him; the Seminoles were great warriors. Unstable as water: the Seminoles were nomads, always moving around, as the scripture said. Thou shalt not excel: Reuben would not excel as the firstborn, because he went up to his father's couch. His birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph because he defiled his father's bed, and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

Simeon is the so-called Dominican and Levi the so-called Haitian today. Simeon and Levi are brethren: all the tribes of Israel are brethren, but these two in particular were to dwell together, and they share the same island, Hispaniola. Instruments of cruelty are in their habitations: the witchcraft practiced on that island, such as the voodoo of Haiti. O my soul, come not thou into their secret: because of those practices the Most High does not unite them, and the two nations stay divided on the island even though Levi helped free Simeon from slavery. For in their anger they slew a man: when their sister was defiled at Shechem, they told all the men of the city to be circumcised, and while the men were sore they slew every male of the city. Simeon and Levi did not play. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel: Levi had no whole portion but cities scattered throughout all the tribes; and as Judah was scattered to the four corners of the earth, so was Levi, for Judah, Benjamin, and Levi make up the southern kingdom.

Judah is the so-called American Black man today. Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: Judah was the first to bring out this truth that we are the nation of Israel, and the great majority of the teachers of this truth today are of the kingdom of Judah. Thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies: Judah sits right in the neck of the enemy's kingdom, right up under Esau here in America, in his politics and his government, always in a key position. Thy father's children shall bow down before thee: Judah is the top tribe in the awakening today, for the Lord saves the tents of Judah first. Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up. The movements that stood up against the enemy in this land, that was Judah rebelling; then he stooped down and couched as an old lion, content, and only the Most High shall rouse him up. The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come: Shiloh means the peaceful one, Christ, who comes from the tribe of Judah, and unto him shall the gathering of the people be. Binding his foal unto the vine is the prophecy of Christ riding into Jerusalem upon the colt; and he washed his garments in wine and his clothes in the blood of grapes runs ahead to Christ returning from Bozrah with dyed garments, treading the winepress, to destroy Israel's enemies. His eyes shall be red with wine: Christ drank wine, so much that men called him a winebibber, but he was never drunken.

Zebulun is the so-called Mayan Indians today, from Guatemala down to Panama. Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea, and he shall be for an haven of ships: the Panama Canal sits in his land, built to shorten the trip around the world, and the ships of the earth must come through and dock there. His border shall be unto Zidon: as Zebulun dwelt by the sea in ancient Israel, so he dwells by the sea now; it was going to be the same, nothing different.

Issachar is the so-called Aztec Indian, the Mexican of today. Issachar is a strong ass: a hard worker, given over to hard work and known over the earth for labor. Couching down between two burdens: the two burdens are North America and Mexico, and the tribe sits pressed between them at the border, under the immigration laws, with even their children detained. He saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant: Mexico is a beautiful land. He bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute: hired out for cheap labor, and that labor is used to undercut and compete with Judah in the market.

Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel. Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward: Dan was like an ambush to the enemies, a powerful tribe that did not play. The tribe of Dan was absorbed into the other tribes, and chiefly into Benjamin; that is part of why Benjamin had so many slave revolts, and successful ones.

Gad is the so-called North American Indian, the Native American, today. Gad, a troop shall overcome him: the United States cavalry led by Andrew Jackson overcame Gad. But he shall overcome at the last: in the last days the tribe of Gad rises back up, as you see it rising now.

Asher is the so-called Incan Indians of South America, dwelling in the places from Colombia on down. Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties: Asher is known for resources, an abundance of natural riches in his land. The blessing of Moses says the same of Asher: let him dip his foot in oil.

Naphtali is the so-called Indians of Argentina and Chile today. Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words, and the capital of Argentina carries that mark, for Buenos Aires means good airs, goodly words.

Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well: Joseph, blessed in his sons Ephraim and Manasseh, is the so-called Puerto Ricans and Cubans today, a fruitful people. Whose branches run over the wall: the Spaniards built a wall in Puerto Rico to keep themselves separate, but the daughters went over the wall and mixed themselves among the people; interracial marriage ran high, and that is why a great part of them favor Esau today. The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him: the Spanish conquistadors. But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob. The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors: they shall be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren; these are the blessings Ephraim and Manasseh received in [Genesis 48](/bible/genesis/48).

Benjamin is the so-called Jamaican today. Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: loud when he communicates, quick to anger, fierce; in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil. With Dan absorbed into him, Benjamin was dangerous in captivity; his slave revolts were plenty, and they were successful.

All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and their father blessed them, every one according to his blessing. The blessings tell who the tribes are and where they would be found in the last days. Jacob charged them to bury him with his fathers in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace, where Abraham and Sarah, Isaac and Rebekah, and Leah lie buried. When Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

The second lot came forth to Simeon, and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah. On the map the whole land Judah possessed is marked as one, and within it sits the portion where Simeon resided, down by Beer-sheba. The so-called Dominicans, of Simeon, were living within the land of the so-called African Americans, of Judah; this is our history and where we lived. It only sounds crazy because we are not taught anything prior to 1492; we are the real Jews, and these maps show where our forefathers and our foremothers were living.

This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families, out of the portion of the children of Judah: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them. Judah had a lot of area and was being his brother's keeper: come dwell with us, Simeon, we got you; therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.

The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families, and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid, twelve cities with their villages. Zebulun sat north, together with Issachar and Asher; those three tribes would always reside together, just like today, and Naphtali stayed close to Asher. The same way, Reuben and Gad were always together on the map. Today Gad and Reuben reside in the United States of America: Reubenites in Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, Louisiana, and Oklahoma, and Gad also in Idaho, North Dakota, South Dakota, Utah, Texas, and New Mexico; they are known today as the North American Indians or First Nations peoples, but according to the Bible they are Israelites. Seminole is not a real nationality; seminole means runaway, and Indian goes into slave or servant. God calls you Reuben, God calls you Israel; the Most High gave you a holy, sanctified, powerful name. We are the twelve tribes, the so-called Blacks, Hispanics, and Native Americans.
The fourth lot came out to Issachar according to their families, and their border was toward Jezreel; their coast reached to Tabor and went out at Jordan, sixteen cities with their villages.

The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families; their border reached to Carmel westward, up to great Zidon and to the strong city Tyre, twenty and two cities with their villages.

The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali; their coast reached to Zebulun on the south side, to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising, meaning the east. The fenced cities are cities with great walls; they were bordered and protected for military purposes, so that the land and the city would not be infiltrated.
The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, with Zorah, Eshtaol, Ajalon, Ekron, and the border before Japho.

The coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: they lost their portion, they let it slip, and they had to go and conquer different territory. Therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, took it, smote it with the edge of the sword, possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

When they had made an end of dividing the land, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun according to the word of the Lord: the city which he asked, Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim; and he built the city and dwelt therein. Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes divided the inheritances by lot in Shiloh before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country; everybody had their portion, and everyone was satisfied.
